description: This Java source file implements an Android AccessibilityService named TaskBackService. The service performs accessibility event handling, extracts view hierarchy information related to a custom list view of tasks, and uses TextToSpeech (TTS) to audibly announce task statuses based on user interactions. It manages TTS initialization, processes accessibility events to generate spoken feedback, and handles view hierarchy traversal to identify task items.

classes.name: TaskBackService
classes.description: An Android AccessibilityService that reads out task list item status changes using TextToSpeech.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes the Text-To-Speech engine when the service is connected.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Handles accessibility events by extracting task-related information from the view hierarchy and speaking it aloud.

methods.name: getListItemNodeInfo
methods.description: Traverses the view hierarchy starting from a node to find the list item node associated with the TaskListView.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Handles service interruption, currently no implementation.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback when TTS engine is initialized; sets language and status flag.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases TTS resources when the service is destroyed.

calls: mTts.speak(String utterance, int queueMode, Bundle params)
